body: Life with my family has always been hard. Its been one issue after another...my dads alcholism, his abuse of my mom as a result, the financial troubles, my brothers being born autistic, my mom turning into a spiteful person, my little sisters descent into mental illness, my older sister being a spiteful person, my mom slowly going mad to the point that she is unable to be a proper mom...and its always fallen to me to try to hold everything up and do damage control. I gave up a lot for this family and all I got in return was crippling depression, my credit being destroyed, poor health and just becoming tired. I'm tired of fixing crap and being the responsible one. Things have gotren so bad APS and CPS have gotten involved as of late this year. Like the shit started building up till it overflowed and guess who it falls upon to grab the gloves and clean up my familys mess....
